## Observation
tests/unit/test_fetch_common_dir_coordination.py:431 asserted a ref-CAS race in 40 uncoordinated rounds and saw 0 (`AssertionError: expected the uncoordinated parallel fetches to race git's ref CAS`). Observed in make verify on worktree fix-chihuahua at commit 4f8cd749a61 (session a85e3cd3, 2026-11-03/04 PST). The run took 3 h 45 min (documented 25-30 min) while other sessions' review-plan gates ran on the host; the test passed in isolation (`pytest -n0 <nodeid>`) on the same code. The commit does not touch this test or its code under test.
The positive control depends on the race actually happening, which host load can prevent, so the test's verdict depends on host scheduling.
## Testing

`pytest tests/unit/test_fetch_common_dir_coordination.py` passes; the forced-race control fails when its hook is made a no-op, and the module passed 5 of 5 runs at load average 42.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Root cause confirmed with a deterministic reproduction (for example the race forced, or the control made independent of scheduling).
- [x] The test's verdict no longer depends on host load.
